Name: Survival Status_Smoking Sickness and Winter
Author: sutooo
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Describe the main purpose of your mod[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]Survival Status adds a layer of tough survival mechanics to Stardew Valley. Experience the consequences of smoking, late nights, and harsh winter weather as you manage your farm.[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Lay out any steps users must follow to install your mod[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]1. Install the latest version of SMAPI (4.0.0 or higher).
2. Install Content Patcher.
3. Extract the mod archive and place the "SurvivalStatus" and "CP_SurvivalStatus" folders into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
4. Launch the game and start your hardcore survival journey![/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Describe the core features of your mod[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]- Smoking: Hold a cigarette and right-click (or press F) to smoke. Buy cigarettes at Pierre's or Joja Mart for 50g.
- Nicotine Poisoning: Smoke 3 cigarettes within 6 hours to get poisoned. Sleep it off to recover.
- Late-Night Sickness: Stay up past 11 PM three nights in a row to fall sick and drain your stamina faster.
- Winter Cold: Going outside at night in winter without a hat may give you a cold.
- Survival Items: Buy a Warm Hat (1000g) at Joja Mart or Sandy's Oasis, and Cold Medicine (250g) or Panacea (500g) at Harvey's Clinic.
- Gift Preferences: Sebastian LOVES cigarettes, but everyone else dislikes them![/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Provide info on additional required steps, resources, or mods[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]- SMAPI 4.0.0+
- Content Patcher[/color]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Say thanks to anyone who inspired or helped you.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]- Thanks to the player for surviving the harsh winter.
- Thanks to Dr. Harvey for providing medical support.
- Thanks to Sebastian for his deep appreciation of the finer things in life.[/color]
